coordinate_system.axes: Original parent pixels: x rightward, y downward
coordinate_system.H: Median normal-body pen-ink height on the source line; runtime uses its unjittered nominal body height.
coordinate_system.measurement_source: Reviewed original-coordinate boxes and direct original RGB pen-ink support. Normalized128px alphas do not supply layout geometry.

trace_artifact.eligibility: Only consecutive accepted normal-body occurrences with measured bottom residuals; omitted or sparse entries end a joint segment.

preserve_native_glyph_geometry.reason: Keep glyph em origin, aspect, terminals and sparse ink placement. Do not normalize tight crop heights or bottom-align every crop.

isotropic_scale.status: Engineering shrinkage; source ratios mix morphology and writing variation.

additional_width_factor.status: Optional only after identity QA; native glyph aspect is preserved by default.

bottom_residual_H.line_centering: After assembling source-backed residuals, subtract line mean and rescale toward zero if necessary to retain maxabs<=0.07. Record centering so replay stays deterministic.
bottom_residual_H.status: Visible-bottom proxy, not recovered true baseline.

edge_gap_H.runtime_advance: Use actual transformed ink width plus this gap; preserve the glyph origin separately.

whole_line_slope_y_down.status: Anatomy-confounded source line rise, conservatively shrunk; displacement cap is engineering safety.

segment_boundary.status: At reset/concatenation, a neutral engineering fallback may be used, but it must remain explicitly unobserved in evidence. Never wrap last-to-first or interpolate over a null as if measured.

recommendations.sparse_glyph_handling: Sparse entries are excluded from joint trace calibration; the renderer must still preserve target sparse glyph morphology/em placement generically, without per-character production branches.

deterministic_replay_contract.seed_material: Compact UTF-8 JSON array [profile_id, style_id, caller_seed, line_index, segment_counter, purpose], ensure_ascii=false.
deterministic_replay_contract.selector: SHA-256(seed_material), first8bytes interpreted big-endian. Select a segment by integer modulo6. Select a suffix phase by a separate purpose hash modulo(n-1), retaining at least2 positions. Log both choices. Other deterministic selection can be used if logged and tested.
deterministic_replay_contract.ordered_tuple: Replay scale proxy, bottom residual and following verified gap from the same source positions in original order. Width factor stays1 by default. Do not independently shuffle dimensions.
deterministic_replay_contract.no_wrap: A phase is a contiguous suffix/prefix consumption, never circular wrap. Stop at the segment end or any null. Choose a fresh segment and mark its boundary as unobserved.
deterministic_replay_contract.line_slope: For a line containing more than one selected segment, derive slope from the first selected source line, shrink and cap it. Do not claim concatenated segment slopes represent one observed source line.
deterministic_replay_contract.rounding: Retain float positions/scales until final raster composition. Overflow handling must preserve relative occurrence transforms.
deterministic_replay_contract.record: Record profile hash, trace artifact hash, seed, selected segment/phase, source occurrence IDs, transforms, boundary fallback markers and collision/overflow checks.

correlation_claim: Ordered replay preserves the local coupling present in six short source fragments. It is a design choice, not an estimated author autocorrelation law.
limits: Only two train parents and22 unique train labels; no repeated training label isolates motor variation from morphology.
Source traces have null holes. Joint replay retains17 full-body positions and11 adjacent pairs across six fragments, max length4.
Visible-bottom and body-size statistics include stroke-terminal anatomy. Do not copy full observed magnitudes into noise or double-add variation already captured by the model.
No validation NIKA-011 numbers fit this profile; its repeated 天 pair is descriptive QA only.
Train broad-versus-strict ink threshold moves each edge≤1px; gap median changes0.148H→0.170H. Crop-box gap median0.081H must not be confused with actual ink gap.
No evidence supports per-glyph rotation/shear; both remain zero.
This does not validate unseen-glyph correctness, product naturalness, long-line behavior or generalization.
required_product_checks: Repeated and unseen glyph identity checked separately from naturalness
Sparse strokes/punctuation handled without per-character branches
Null discontinuities and synthetic reset gaps explicitly retained in logs
